notablePrerequisites:
You control up to six other lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
description:
Activate up to six lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Minamo and up to six other lands.
Holding priority, activate Minamo and up to six other lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping Minamo and up to six other lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Bottomless Pool by paying {U}, unlocking it.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.
